source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because my landing page is adult-oriented, it will not be useful for this creative. We do have many customer reviews, but most came through calls, are not recorded on the site, and are generally not in a proper format. It would therefore be better for you to create the testimonial material independently. Our product mostly attracts an audience aged 28-54.

value_updates.testimonial_material_source: created independently rather than sourced from existing recorded customer reviews

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao, I understand the direction you’re aiming for, and those are excellent points.

Rather than copying the current winning ad, I’ll create an original testimonial-style concept with realistic AI-generated Indian actors, preferably male. Strong hooks and strategic cuts will support retention, while professionally balanced audio will ensure the result meets social-media standards.

Where appropriate, I’ll also rewrite the script to improve engagement without moving the messaging away from your product or target audience.

I’ll now prepare and send an offer that reflects everything we’ve discussed.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

Rather than editing the previous version, I've rebuilt the concept completely around your feedback. The result is a fast-paced, 45-second testimonial-style UGC ad featuring multiple Indian testimonials. It retains the same high-converting keywords and psychology without feeling like a copy of the winning creative.

The revised execution includes:

- A stronger and more direct hook

- A fresh concept instead of a copied reference

- Testimonial-style presentation

- Faster pacing designed for Meta

- Keywords centered on energy, confidence, stamina, and performance

- Indian actors, with visual flow and editing opportunities that suit the concept

Before I prepare the final production prompt and begin scene-by-scene execution, please review this version and confirm whether it aligns with the direction you want.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports having rebuilt the concept as a 45-second testimonial-style UGC ad featuring multiple Indian testimonials.

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to set independent creativity aside changes the broader creative direction to reference adaptation; it does not explicitly remove the requirement to create testimonial material independently from unavailable customer recordings.
